/* com.kt.openapi.web.devsupport.dao.DevSupportDAO.selDevSupportList */
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY REG_DT DESC) rownum ,PSTING_ID ,BBS_TYPE_CD ,PSTING_NO ,TITLE ,SBST ,RETV_NUM ,SHOW_YN ,IMPT_YN ,DEL_YN ,TO_CHAR(REG_DT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') REG_DT ,REGR ,AMD_DT ,COALESCE(AMDR,'') AS AMDR ,DEVSUPPORT_GB ,SERVICEINFRA_NM AS SERVICEINFRAN ,STATUS ,DEVSUPPORT_GB supportgb FROM KOA_TB_DEVSUPPORT_BBS

/* com.kt.openapi.web.devsupport.dao.DevSupportDAO.selDevSupportFileList */ SELECT ATC_FILE_NO, DEVSUPPORT_BBS_ID AS PSTING_ID, FILE_TYPE_CD, FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE, ORIGIN_FILE_NM, SAVE_FILE_NM, USE_YN, DOWNL_CNT, SHOW_ODRG, REG_DT, COALESCE(REGR,'') AS REGR, AMD_DT, COALESCE(AMDR,'') AS AMDR FROM KOA_TB_DEVSUPPORT_BBS_ATC WHERE 1=1 AND DEVSUPPORT_BBS_ID = #{pstingId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

/* com.kt.openapi.web.devsupport.dao.DevSupportDAO.selDevSupportSdk */ SELECT ORIGIN_FILE_NM, FILE_PATH, FILE_TYPE_CD, SAVE_FILE_NM FROM KOA_TB_DEVSUPPORT_SDK AA INNER JOIN KOA_TB_DEVSUPPORT_BBS_ATC BB ON AA.SDKPOST_ID = BB.DEVSUPPORT_BBS_ID WHERE FILE_TYPE_CD = 'FILTYP6000' ORDER BY SDKPOST_ID DESC LIMIT 1
